fields.Name: Rubric Evaluator
fields.Description: The parent prompt of the LLM rubric evaluator. Renders the rubric's instructions, each criterion's rendered text (Criteria[].Text), the rules, and the reply contract the engine parses (SinglePass: decisions[]; PerCriterion: chosen + probabilities). The judge prompt renders into its judgePrompt slot. The subject is not in this template: it arrives as a separate, delimited user message. Swap it (SystemPromptID / SystemPromptName) only with a prompt that returns the same JSON. Template data: Rubric, Mode, Criteria, Subject; see the Rubrics Guide.

fields.Name: Rubric Criterion
fields.Description: Renders one rubric criterion as text: name, key, gate, description, guidance, hints, the evidence rule, the not-applicable rule, and its scale with each level's anchor. Rendered only, never sent to a model on its own. The LLM evaluator places the result in Criteria[].Text, and the Decision evaluator uses it as each Score question's instructions, so both describe a criterion the same way. Template data: Rubric, Criterion.
